intro.text: A cousin of Lopen who joined Bridge Four after it moved to the Kholin warcamp.
One of Lopen's Herdazian cousins, a member of Bridge Four who was killed at the Battle of Narak.

items.text: Rod and his cousin Huio joined Bridge Four after the crew moved to Dalinar's warcamp, and trained with the other new recruits.
Rod was killed by the Parshendi during the Battle of Narak.
Though Kaladin hardly knew Rod, he had felt responsible for protecting him, and Rod was among the people Kaladin remembered as he tried to speak the Fourth Ideal.
Following Herdazian custom toward poorer cousins, Lopen, Huio and Punio send a large share of their Radiant stipends to Rod's family.

personality.text: Speaks little Alethi but comes across as jovial.
